name: audio_keepalive
description: Maintains continuous audio output to prevent HDMI/SPDIF/USB signal loss during idle
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: Keeps a continuous inaudible noise mix on the output so HDMI receivers, SPDIF decoders, and USB DACs do not drop lock when idle
volumio_info.changelog: v2.0.0: Continuous mix daemon. Virtual PCM forwards music; daemon always owns the output and mixes inaudible Gaussian noise. No switching, no volume control.
